description: Hand-labelled expected retrieval routes (docs/query-routing.md). Labels were written from each question's retrieval need BEFORE the router was run against them and were not edited afterwards. 'scenario' tags cases whose retrieval outcome is exercised by unit/e2e tests (stale, conflicting, unauthorized evidence); the route label is what is measured here.
